recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Neon Quill Rush**, a portrait-first browser endless runner platformer. Preserve the original mechanics: a fixed-x avatar advances through camera auto-scroll, taps or Space trigger a jump with a two-jump cap, gravity pulls the runner down, generated rectangular platforms reset jumps on landing, pickups add +100 to the distance score, falling below the screen ends the run, and restart returns to the same loop.

Transform the public identity into a Sonic-inspired but original neon arcade speedway: a procedural blue quill-runner with red shoes and cyan aura, magenta/cyan loop rails, gold ring collectibles, parallax cyber-city silhouettes, grid horizon, loop arcs, speed streaks, comic attitude typography, compact mobile HUD, and clear CTAs for Start Dash and Run It Back.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: endless auto-scrolling platform runner
- objective: keep the avatar on procedurally generated platforms while collecting optional pickups for bonus score and surviving distance for continuous score.
- input model: pointer/touch on the canvas or Space key triggers a jump; the avatar can jump twice before landing.
- core loop: start run, camera scrolls right, player falls under gravity, land on platforms to reset jumps, collect pickups, generate new platforms, fall below screen to game over, restart.
- fail/friction state: falling below the lower screen threshold triggers game over, score save, final/best display, and restart CTA.

## Protected Mechanics
- Auto-scroll camera and fixed screen-space player x.
- Gravity, jump force, two-jump limit, platform AABB landing, generated platform/gap ranges, collectible +100 bonus, distance scoring, fall failure, restart flow.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD copy, title, fonts, colors, procedural canvas drawing, background layers, platform/ring/player form language, particle colors/shapes, feedback messages, audio labels, and mobile visual hierarchy are safe to transform as presentation.
